_comment: The public repository's About box. The owner applies it with: gh repo edit RadishSoftware/mobster --description "$(jq -r .description packaging/public-repo.json)" --homepage "$(jq -r .homepage packaging/public-repo.json)" $(jq -r '.topics[] | "--add-topic " + .' packaging/public-repo.json). The description names testing on your own iPhone: until that has been checked end to end on a real phone, drop "your phone and". Every topic is something Mobster does today; never a tool it doesn't run. When Codex and Cursor are tested, codex and cursor replace model-context-protocol and mobile-agent.
description: Agents on a real iPhone: test your iOS app on your phone and simulators, and run tasks in your apps. CLI, MCP server and agent loop, over USB. MIT.
